The worker records this and executes the UNCHANGED original file phase_dynamics.py by path (package __init__ bypassed); its raw hash equals the inventory. No environment changed.
The original kernel consumes the global NumPy RNG in every case even at noise_level=0 (recorded); the lab core has no random source.
The original kernel silently ignores C_ij <= 0 and accepts asymmetric matrices; the lab core rejects both explicitly.
